name: Snapsmaps
description: Your own self-hostable social media application. Easily share photos with a map pin to friends and family. -- Features • Fully optimized for mobile devices • Social media profile functionality • Photo location markers via Open Street Map • Basic notification system • Photo collections • User follow system • Comment functionality • Secure, email-verified account registration • NSFW submission tagging • Admin tooling • Limited guest access (no account required) • Seamless post and collection sharing with OpenGraph metadata integration

paths.name: Content
paths.description: This is where Snapsmaps will store user content

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Replace with any randomly generated string. This is used in user session creation. Changing it will invalidate any active sessions.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.description: The primary hosting domain. e.x https://mysnapsmapsdomain.com

variables.name: ALLOWED_DOMAINS
variables.description: Also known as cors domains. You do not need to add the DOMAIN set domain to this list.

variables.name: ADMINS
variables.description: Comma seperated list of account admins emails. Your account email should be listed.

variables.name: SECURE_COOKIES
variables.description: If set to true, the site must be access from https. Set to false if accessing from http. If accessing from http then log in sessions will not be created. tl;dr If you enable this, your users must access it from https in order to log in.

variables.name: Max Photo Upload Size (MB)
variables.description: The maximum allowed upload size for photos in megabytes

variables.name: Manifest Start URL
variables.description: The site manifest start_url. Generally this should be your domain. e.x https://mydomain.tld

variables.name: Manifest Site name
variables.description: Needed for the manifiest and for opengraph metadata.

variables.name: Manifest ID
variables.description: Put some randomly genearted string here that is unique

variables.name: Manifest Site Description
variables.value: Easily share photos with a map pin to friends and family.
variables.description: Needed for the manifiest and for opengraph metadata.
